$comment: The narration templates of tools/autonomy/explain.py (TEMPLATES, FLAG_ORDER, TERMINAL_OF) at mesh-tree commit 4f56fd1, dumped by json.dump(sort_keys=True); the studio's attempt cards render records against them.

PF-BUDGET.because: a config whose octree alone exceeds the budget would fail on cost
PF-BUDGET.title: check the octree probe's leaf count against the cell budget

PF-CONFIG.because: the mirror of the parser refuses what the mesher would refuse, on the same field
PF-CONFIG.title: check that the mesher's own parser and validator accept the config

PF-DOMAIN.because: a surface that touches the domain boundary without spanning it cannot be meshed as a body
PF-DOMAIN.title: check that the domain holds the surface with margin

PF-FLAGS.because: no run may pass the permissive flag
PF-FLAGS.title: check the command line for forbidden flags

PF-KNOBS.because: a config the mesher would reject, or a knob outside the table, is refused before any run
PF-KNOBS.title: check every settings leaf against the whitelist, its range and the mesher's parser

PF-NONORTH.because: a two-to-one octree transition sets a non-orthogonality floor that no refined mesh can go below
PF-NONORTH.title: check that the non-orthogonality ceiling clears the octree floor

PF-PATCH.because: a layer or band on a patch the surface does not have is refused by the mesher
PF-PATCH.title: check that every named patch is one of the surface's own

PF-QUALITY.because: the gate that judges a mesh is fixed; a config that alters it is refused
PF-QUALITY.title: check that the quality block equals the reference

PF-SURFACE.because: an open or inverted surface cannot be meshed, so it is refused before any run
PF-SURFACE.title: check that every surface is closed and consistently wound

PF-THIN.because: a first layer too thin for its wall cells makes every layer cell fail the quality gate, so the mesher drops them
PF-THIN.title: check the first layer against the thickness-ratio gate at the wall edge

PF-YPLUS.because: the first layer must meet y+ at most one while the stack fits under the cell limiter, at a level the octree can reach
PF-YPLUS.title: check that the a priori y+ window is non-empty and reachable

R-BUDGET.because: far-field bands are coarsened first and the wall last, so the cells fit with the least loss at the wall
R-BUDGET.title: coarsen the ladder until the predicted cells fit the budget

R-CURV.because: a wall cell larger than a fraction of the curvature radius cannot follow the surface
R-CURV.title: refine the wall where the curvature radius is small

R-DOM.because: the domain keeps fixed multiples of the reference length upstream, downstream and on each side
R-DOM.title: set the base cell size and the domain extent from the reference length

R-FEAT.because: sharp edges need finer cells to be captured by the snap
R-FEAT.title: raise the feature level where the body has sharp edges

R-GAP.because: a gap needs several cells across it to be resolved
R-GAP.title: refine the wall where two surfaces face each other across a small gap

R-PLANE.because: when the faces lie on the lattice the walls need no snapping, and the layers are delivered
R-PLANE.title: put a commensurate body's faces on cell planes

R-WIN.because: the wall cell must be thick enough for the stack under the limiter and thin enough for the thickness-ratio gate
R-WIN.title: pick the wall level and the growth inside the feasible window

R-YP.because: the flat-plate skin-friction correlation gives the friction velocity, and the first cell height follows from y+ at most one
R-YP.title: set the first layer thickness from the a priori wall unit

RM-BUDGET-FAR.because: a run over the cell budget or out of time sheds far-field cells first
RM-BUDGET-FAR.title: halve the far-field band distances

RM-BUDGET-FEAT.because: after the far field, the feature refinement is the next cost to shed
RM-BUDGET-FEAT.title: drop the feature bump to the wall level

RM-BUDGET-WALL.because: the wall level is the last cost to shed, and never below the level that y+ needs
RM-BUDGET-WALL.title: coarsen the whole refinement ladder one level, not below the y+ floor

RM-CAPABILITY-LIMITED.because: the mesher drops layers on a snapped wall by name, so no further trial is spent on them
RM-CAPABILITY-LIMITED.title: end the geometry: the layers are limited by the mesher's capability

RM-EXHAUSTED.because: each remedy fires at most twice, no config is revisited, and the attempt count is capped
RM-EXHAUSTED.title: end the geometry: the attempts or the remedies are spent

RM-LAYER-FIT.because: the stack is trimmed by the limiter, so the growth or the first layer is lowered until it fits
RM-LAYER-FIT.title: fit the stack under the cell limiter

RM-NO-REMEDY.because: a surface defect, a config the mesher rejects, a harness fault or a quality gate is not something a bounded edit may change
RM-NO-REMEDY.title: end the geometry: the failure is outside the remedy table

RM-PASS.because: no failure flag is set and no requested layer patch is dropped or trimmed
RM-PASS.title: end the geometry: the attempt passes

RM-PLANE.because: a layer drop on a snapped wall goes to the plane rule when the body is commensurate
RM-PLANE.title: put the body on cell planes with the plane rule

RM-PLANE-FINER.because: a finer divisor shrinks the wall cell so that the stack meets the corner bound
RM-PLANE-FINER.title: take the next lattice divisor on the plane path

RM-SNAP-FT.because: the pilot sweep found that it unpins the snap on every feature-bearing body, at the cost of the edges not being captured
RM-SNAP-FT.title: switch the feature attraction off

RM-SNAP-REFINE.because: the snapped surface misses area, so the lattice is too coarse for the body
RM-SNAP-REFINE.title: refine the whole refinement ladder one level

RM-SNAP-WALL.because: the pilot sweep found one level coarser the only snap-clean change with the feature attraction on
RM-SNAP-WALL.title: coarsen the whole refinement ladder one level, not below the y+ floor

RM-T1-RAISE.because: the first layer is thinner than the thickness-ratio gate allows, and a thicker one still meets y+
RM-T1-RAISE.title: raise the first layer to its y+ bound

RM-T1-REFINE.because: smaller wall cells let the same first layer pass the thickness-ratio gate
RM-T1-REFINE.title: refine the whole refinement ladder one level

RM-TOPO-REFINE.because: a missing wall patch or a split fluid region means the lattice is too coarse for the body's topology
RM-TOPO-REFINE.title: refine the whole refinement ladder one level

WL-FLAG.because: the permissive flag would let a mesh past the quality gate, and it is never passed
WL-FLAG.title: refuse a forbidden command-line flag

WL-FORBIDDEN.because: the quality gate, the permissive flag and the layer limiters are never tuned: the loop improves meshes, it does not loosen the gate that judges them
WL-FORBIDDEN.title: refuse an edit to a knob outside the action space

WL-POINTER.because: every edit names one config leaf by an RFC pointer
WL-POINTER.title: refuse an edit whose target is not a JSON pointer

WL-RANGE.because: the knob table bounds every knob, including the ones the mesher's validator leaves unchecked
WL-RANGE.title: refuse an edit whose value lies outside the knob's legal range

WL-TYPE.because: the knob table declares each knob's type, and the mesher's parser would reject another
WL-TYPE.title: refuse an edit whose value has the wrong type

WL-UNLISTED.because: only knobs in the locked legal-range table may be changed
WL-UNLISTED.title: refuse an edit to a knob that is not on the whitelist
